items.description: Laptop screen crack repair (complete display assembly)
items.rationale: Cracked screen from the swerve is covered under 2.6.2 and 2.6.3(a). Battery was found fine, so 2.6.8 does not apply. Display is the main cost; the laptop cost about 1,400 and repair is less than replacement, so no cap. The invoice total is near 1,300, and the display is most of it, so I estimate about 850 gross.

items.description: Lower-right corner and housing repair (new lower shell)
items.rationale: Housing and corner damage from the same event is covered under 2.6.3(b) even if operation is unaffected. A new lower shell with labour is an ordinary repair, estimated at about 280 gross.
Treating a pre-existing surface condition is not a repair cost under 7.1.11 and 7.1.8(a), even if on the same invoice. t = 0.
Examination of a damaged unit in an insured event is reimbursed under 5.2.3, capped at EUR 250 incl. VAT. A typical diagnostic charge is cheaper than the cap, so about 60 gross.
